```{r Load & Preprocess KV1.3 Bulk RNA-Seq Data}
# Load Count Data & Metadata
KV1.3.Brain.count <- readRDS("~/Desktop/KV1.3.BRAIN/KV1.3.Brain.count.rds")
Brain_Metadata <- readRDS("~/Desktop/KV1.3.BRAIN/Brain_Metadata.rds")
# Filter genes with low expression
#filtered_counts <- KV1.3.Brain.count[rowMeans(KV1.3.Brain.count) > 10, ]
# Convert Treatment to Factor
Brain_Metadata$Treatment <- factor(Brain_Metadata$Treatment)

# Create Metadata Data Frame
metadata <- data.frame(
  row.names = colnames(KV1.3.Brain.count),
  Treatment = Brain_Metadata$Treatment
)

# Subset Metadata for PAP1 vs Control
metadata.PAP1.Control <- subset(metadata, Treatment %in% c("PAP1", "Control"))

# Subset Count Data
filtered_counts_PAP1_Control <- KV1.3.Brain.count[, rownames(metadata.PAP1.Control)]

# Save Processed Data
saveRDS(filtered_counts_PAP1_Control, "filtered_counts_PAP1_Control.without.filter.rds")

```


```{r WGCNA for PAP1 vs Control}
# Extract Expression Data for Gene Sets
mito_counts <- filtered_counts_PAP1_Control[rownames(filtered_counts_PAP1_Control) %in% mitochondrial.Pro.resilience, ]
synaptic_counts <- filtered_counts_PAP1_Control[rownames(filtered_counts_PAP1_Control) %in% synaptic.Pro.resilience, ]
ribosomal_counts <- filtered_counts_PAP1_Control[rownames(filtered_counts_PAP1_Control) %in% ribosomes.Pro.resilience, ]
write.csv(mito_counts, file = 'mito_counts.PAP1.vs.Control.csv')
write.csv(synaptic_counts, file = 'synaptic_counts.PAP1.vs.Control.csv')
write.csv(ribosomal_counts, file = 'ribosomal_counts.PAP1.vs.Control.csv')
```


```{r Calculate Module Eigengenes (MEs) for Each Gene Set PAP1 vs. Control}
count_data <- filtered_counts_PAP1_Control
# Load required libraries
library(WGCNA)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)

# Ensure WGCNA settings
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Function to compute Module Eigengenes (MEs)
compute_MEs <- function(count_data) {
  datExpr <- t(count_data)  # Transpose so genes are columns, samples are rows
  datExpr <- as.data.frame(datExpr)

  # Assign all genes to a single module
  module_colors <- rep("Module1", ncol(datExpr))

  # Compute Module Eigengenes
  MEs <- moduleEigengenes(datExpr, colors = module_colors)$eigengenes
  return(list(MEs = MEs, datExpr = datExpr))  # Return both MEs and transformed data
}

# Compute MEs for each gene set (store transformed expression data too)
MEs_mito <- compute_MEs(filtered_counts_PAP1_Control[rownames(filtered_counts_PAP1_Control) %in% mitochondrial.Pro.resilience, ])
MEs_synaptic <- compute_MEs(filtered_counts_PAP1_Control[rownames(filtered_counts_PAP1_Control) %in% synaptic.Pro.resilience, ])
MEs_ribosomal <- compute_MEs(filtered_counts_PAP1_Control[rownames(filtered_counts_PAP1_Control) %in% ribosomes.Pro.resilience, ])

# Verify output
head(MEs_mito$MEs$MEModule1)

# Function to compute kME values
compute_kME <- function(datExpr, MEs) {
  kMEdat <- signedKME(datExpr, MEs$MEs, outputColumnName = "kME_")
  return(kMEdat)
}

# Compute kME for each gene set
kME_mito <- compute_kME(MEs_mito$datExpr, MEs_mito)
kME_synaptic <- compute_kME(MEs_synaptic$datExpr, MEs_synaptic)
kME_ribosomal <- compute_kME(MEs_ribosomal$datExpr, MEs_ribosomal)

# Save kME tables to Excel
write_xlsx(list(
  Mitochondrial = as.data.frame(kME_mito),
  Synaptic = as.data.frame(kME_synaptic),
  Ribosomal = as.data.frame(kME_ribosomal)
), "kME_tables.PAP1.vs.Control.xlsx")

print("kME calculations and Excel file saved successfully!")
head(MEs_mito, 5)
head(MEs_synaptic, 5)
head(MEs_ribosomal, 5)

```
```{r Boxplots with Significance Bars}
# Prepare data for boxplots
MEs_combined <- data.frame(
  Eigengene = c(MEs_mito$MEs$MEModule1, MEs_synaptic$MEs$MEModule1, MEs_ribosomal$MEs$MEModule1),
  Module = rep(c("Mitochondrial", "Synaptic", "Ribosomal"), each = nrow(metadata.PAP1.Control)),
  Treatment = rep(metadata.PAP1.Control$Treatment, 3)
)

# Save
write.csv(MEs_combined, file = 'MEs_combined.PAP1.vs.Control.csv')

# Generate boxplots with significance bars
ggboxplot(MEs_combined, x = "Treatment", y = "Eigengene", fill = "Treatment",
          palette = c("PAP1" = "purple", "Control" = "darkgreen")) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", label = "p.format", 
                     comparisons = list(c("PAP1", "Control"))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Pro.resilience in PAP1 vs Control",
       x = "Treatment",
       y = "Eigengene") +
  facet_wrap(~ Module, scales = "free_y")  # Separate plots for each module


```
```{r  WGCNA for ShK vs PBS}
# Extract Data for ShK and PBS
# Subset Metadata for ShK and PBS
Brain_Metadata <- readRDS("~/Desktop/KV1.3.BRAIN/Brain_Metadata.rds")
metadata <- Brain_Metadata
metadata.ShK.PBS <- subset(Brain_Metadata, Treatment %in% c("ShK", "PBS"))
# Ensure row names match before subsetting count data
matched_samples_ShK_PBS <- rownames(metadata.ShK.PBS)[rownames(metadata.ShK.PBS) %in% colnames(KV1.3.Brain.count)]
# Subset Count Data
filtered_counts_ShK_PBS <- KV1.3.Brain.count[, matched_samples_ShK_PBS]
# Save Processed Data
saveRDS(filtered_counts_ShK_PBS, "filtered_counts_ShK_PBS.without.filter.rds")
# Extract Expression Data for Gene Sets (Corrected Filtering for ShK vs PBS)
mito_counts_ShK_PBS <- filtered_counts_ShK_PBS[rownames(filtered_counts_ShK_PBS) %in% mitochondrial.Pro.resilience, ]
synaptic_counts_ShK_PBS <- filtered_counts_ShK_PBS[rownames(filtered_counts_ShK_PBS) %in% synaptic.Pro.resilience, ]
ribosomal_counts_ShK_PBS <- filtered_counts_ShK_PBS[rownames(filtered_counts_ShK_PBS) %in% ribosomes.Pro.resilience, ]
# Save Filtered Gene Counts as CSV
write.csv(mito_counts_ShK_PBS, file = 'mito_counts.ShK.vs.PBS.csv')
write.csv(synaptic_counts_ShK_PBS, file = 'synaptic_counts.ShK.vs.PBS.csv')
write.csv(ribosomal_counts_ShK_PBS, file = 'ribosomal_counts.ShK.vs.PBS.csv')
print("ShK vs PBS data extraction and saving completed successfully!")
```
```{r Calculate Module Eigengenes (MEs) for Each Gene Set ShK vs. PBS}
# Calculate Module Eigengenes (MEs) for Each Gene Set ShK vs. PBS
count_data <- filtered_counts_ShK_PBS

# Load required libraries
library(WGCNA)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)

# Ensure WGCNA settings
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Function to compute Module Eigengenes (MEs)
compute_MEs <- function(count_data) {
  datExpr <- t(count_data)  # Transpose so genes are columns, samples are rows
  datExpr <- as.data.frame(datExpr)

  # Assign all genes to a single module
  module_colors <- rep("Module1", ncol(datExpr))

  # Compute Module Eigengenes
  MEs <- moduleEigengenes(datExpr, colors = module_colors)$eigengenes
  return(list(MEs = MEs, datExpr = datExpr))  # Return both MEs and transformed data
}

# Compute MEs for each gene set (store transformed expression data too)
MEs_mito <- compute_MEs(filtered_counts_ShK_PBS[rownames(filtered_counts_ShK_PBS) %in% mitochondrial.Pro.resilience, ])
MEs_synaptic <- compute_MEs(filtered_counts_ShK_PBS[rownames(filtered_counts_ShK_PBS) %in% synaptic.Pro.resilience, ])
MEs_ribosomal <- compute_MEs(filtered_counts_ShK_PBS[rownames(filtered_counts_ShK_PBS) %in% ribosomes.Pro.resilience, ])

# Verify output
head(MEs_mito$MEs, 5)  # FIXED: Accessing eigengenes correctly

# Function to compute kME values
compute_kME <- function(datExpr, MEs) {
  if (nrow(datExpr) != nrow(MEs$MEs)) {
    stop("Error: Mismatched rows in datExpr and MEs$MEs")
  }
  kMEdat <- signedKME(datExpr, MEs$MEs, outputColumnName = "kME_")
  return(kMEdat)
}

# Compute kME for each gene set
kME_mito <- compute_kME(MEs_mito$datExpr, MEs_mito)
kME_synaptic <- compute_kME(MEs_synaptic$datExpr, MEs_synaptic)
kME_ribosomal <- compute_kME(MEs_ribosomal$datExpr, MEs_ribosomal)

# Save kME tables to Excel (Fixed file name)
write_xlsx(list(
  Mitochondrial = as.data.frame(kME_mito),
  Synaptic = as.data.frame(kME_synaptic),
  Ribosomal = as.data.frame(kME_ribosomal)
), "kME_tables.ShK.vs.PBS.xlsx")

print("kME calculations and Excel file saved successfully!")

# Display first 5 rows of eigengenes (Fixed)
head(MEs_mito$MEs, 5)
head(MEs_synaptic$MEs, 5)
head(MEs_ribosomal$MEs, 5)
#Boxplots with Significance Bars
# Prepare data for boxplots
MEs_combined <- data.frame(
  Eigengene = c(MEs_mito$MEs$MEModule1, MEs_synaptic$MEs$MEModule1, MEs_ribosomal$MEs$MEModule1),
  Module = rep(c("Mitochondrial", "Synaptic", "Ribosomal"), each = nrow(metadata.ShK.PBS)),
  Treatment = rep(metadata.ShK.PBS$Treatment, 3)
)

# Save
write.csv(MEs_combined, file = 'MEs_combined.ShK.vs.PBS.csv')

# Generate boxplots with significance bars
ggboxplot(MEs_combined, x = "Treatment", y = "Eigengene", fill = "Treatment",
          palette = c("ShK" = "purple", "PBS" = "darkgreen")) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", label = "p.format", 
                     comparisons = list(c("ShK", "PBS"))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Pro.resilience in ShK.vs.PBS",
       x = "Treatment",
       y = "Eigengene") +
  facet_wrap(~ Module, scales = "free_y")  # Separate plots for each module

```
